name: BBGI Public Company Limited
summary: BBGI Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and distributes biofuel and related products in Thailand. It operates in three segments: Biodiesel, Ethanol, and Others. The company offers biodiesel products, such as glycerine and methyl ester products; and bioethanol products. It also provides bio-based products. BBGI Public Company Limited was incorporated in 2018 and is headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand.
